text:
Riley: Heads up Team — we're doing a quick company holiday card photo + tiny bake-off next Wednesday (12/22) at 4pm in the lobby. Quick RSVP? :camera_with_flash:
Noor: RSVP yes 37a9c1 I'll bring oat-based ginger cookies (vegan).
Ben: I'll be there. Can I bribe photo-bot for a candid shot? :grin:
Priya: Remote that day but can I drop off cookies at reception earlier? Also happy to help with props. :sparkles:
Lucas: I'll bring a goofy hat and a small string of lights. Also: quick question, is the card digital only or printing some copies?
Riley: Digital-first + a couple printed for the lobby. Photo-bot will auto-crop for 1024x1024.
Kim: Tiny bake-off rules: 1) under $15 ingredients, 2) label allergens, 3) bonus points for festive presentation. Winner gets a small Redwood mug & bragging rights. :trophy:
ops-bot: Event created: "Holiday Card + Bake-off" 2025-12-22 16:00-16:45  calendar: https://calendar.example/events/holiday-6789
photo-bot: Reminder: please wear company badge for the photo. Bring something reflective for lights if you want that twinkle effect. :sparkles:
Riley: If you're remote but want to be in the card, DM me a selfie and I'll try to slot it in for the collage.
Noor: Also vote on background: react with :snowflake: for snowy window, :evergreen_tree: for lobby tree, :city_sunset: for studio backdrop.
Ben: :evergreen_tree:
Priya: :snowflake: (drop off cookies 9am front desk)
Lucas: :evergreen_tree: + will bring fairy lights
Kim: :evergreen_tree: (bake-off judge volunteer here)
Riley: Ok majority evergreen_tree 332 389. I'll post final schedule and a label template.
Ben: Friendly reminder: no perfume or strong scents in the lobby pls (allergy-safe).
Noor: Thanks, noted.
Priya: Sending a quick list of allergy labels I used last year: 
Priya: ```
Contains: nuts, dairy-free, gluten-free, vegan friendly
Please notify host if you have other allergies
```
Riley: Love it. Will print adhesive labels. Anyone want to help set up at 3:30p? 
Lucas: I can help with lights & table layout at 3:30.
Kim: I'll hang tiny signage and bring tape.
Riley: Perfect. See you all (and cookies) Wednesday. Happy almost-holidays everyone! :holidays:
